terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using Udomi Me, you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully.
terms.section1Text: Udomi Me is a free platform to connect animals in need with loving adopters. You agree to use the platform only for lawful purposes and in a manner consistent with animal welfare.
terms.section2Text: You are responsible for the accuracy of all listings you post. Misleading, fraudulent, or abusive listings are strictly prohibited and will result in account removal.
terms.section3Text: We collect your name, email, and listing data to operate the service. We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Contact information shared on listings is your responsibility.
terms.section4Text: All users must ensure the welfare of animals listed or adopted through this platform. Udomi Me does not accept responsibility for the condition or care of animals after adoption.
terms.section5Text: We reserve the right to terminate accounts that violate these terms, without prior notice.
terms.section6Text: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of any changes.
